experiments.mechanism: Issue #67 maintained domain validation before probability correction; bounded cosine roundoff and atomic borrowed-score mutation.

conditions.execution: selected maintained scalar C++ body; no Torch/CUDA/OpenMP execution
conditions.cosine_tolerance: 8 * float epsilon in normalized cosine units
conditions.accepted: finite scores, positive finite norms/scaling, K>=1,L>=2,nnz>=0, caller-valid buffers and bounded indices
conditions.rejection: invalid_argument for scalar/parameter domain errors; overflow_error for unrepresentable corrected scores; no partial mutation
conditions.empty: valid nnz=0 is no-op and allows null buffers

experiments.note: Raw kernel cannot establish index upper bounds. Server callers must validate outside OpenMP regions or capture and transport worker exceptions after joining; native wrapper runtime is not evidence from this suite.
